name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 45 – Am 31
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 45b. Denounces the inconsistency of certain Member States, notably Italy, which withdrew from the Energy Charter Treaty to escape investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) constraints on public policy; emphasises that the Investment Court System replicates the core features of ISDS by enabling investors to challenge public-interest regulation before an international tribunal; calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure consistency with the Energy Charter Treaty withdrawal and to safeguard the right to regulate in the public interest;
